data.title: Tropical Storm Fay (AT1), advisory 26/0258Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: FAY CONTINUES TO WEAKEN OVER THE ATLANTIC OCEAN. As of 3:00 AM GMT Sat Sep 26 the center of Fay was located near 29.9, -43.4 with movement WSW at 7 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1006 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 40 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Odalys (EP1), advisory 26/0252Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: ODALYS STILL A MAJOR HURRICANE AS IT MOVES SLOWLY NORTHWARD. As of 8:00 PM PDT Fri Sep 25 the center of Odalys was located near 18.8, -123.6 with movement N at 5 mph. The minimum central pressure was 952 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 120 mph.

data.title: Tropical Storm Gonzalo (AT2), advisory 26/0232Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: GONZALO WEAKENS AS IT CONTINUES NORTHWARD. As of 2:00 AM CVT Sat Sep 26 the center of Gonzalo was located near 16.9, -22.5 with movement N at 9 mph. The minimum central pressure was 1002 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 45 mph.

data.title: Hurricane Polo (EP2), advisory 26/0553Z
data.author: nhcwebmaster@noaa.gov (NHC Webmaster)
data.summary: POLO REMAINS AN EXTREMELY DANGEROUS CATEGORY 5 HURRICANE. ...EXPECTED TO MAKE LANDFALL IN BAJA CALIFORNIA SUR ON MONDAY AS A POWERFUL HURRICANE... As of 11:00 PM MST Fri Sep 25 the center of Polo was located near 17.5, -110.5 with movement WNW at 10 mph. The minimum central pressure was 911 mb with maximum sustained winds of about 175 mph.
